title: [AAPS 3.0.0.1] Frequent pump unreachable errors with Orangelink and Emalink
body:
Pixel 4a 5g Android 12
AAPS build479bfc410

On three occasions now either the orangelink or emalink has disconnected from AAPS

Log is from 11Feb noticed issue around about 9 AM

I received an alert that my pump was unreachable.
Steps I took to fix the issue (play protect is disabled - verified that it is off):
1) Refreshed pod status
2) Scan for link
3) Remove link and re-scan
4) switch to virtual pump then back to eros to restart pump driver
5) restart AAPS
6) restart phone

Both links are able to connect to to nRF connect. Sometimes the link will connect but it fails to refresh. Other times it stays in the initialization step

Reporting bugs
--------------
- **Note the precise time the problem occurred** and describe the circumstances and steps that caused
  the problem
- Note the Build version (found in the About dialog in the app, when pressing the three dots in the
  upper-right corner).
- Obtain the app's log files, which can be found on the phone in
  _/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/info.nightscout.androidaps/_
  See https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/Usage/Accessing-logfiles.html
- Open an issue at https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/new
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1644588029325.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8052413/AndroidAPS_LOG_1644588029325.log.zip)
